title: Köpek Olmak İsteyen Kedi
author: Öznur Karaeloğlu
description: Murmur is a young stray cat who has just left his family. One day, when he is very hungry, he finds a doghouse with a piece of meat and starts eating. He thinks about how lucky dogs are, but meeting the kennel’s real owner changes his journey. Murmur learns that luck does not determine his path, that it is important to be oneself, and that friendship, cooperation, and sharing can help us create our own luck.
english_title: The Cat That Wanted To Be A Dog
